Method of Attack: Fileless malware executing directly from memory
Loading a precompiled, base64-encoded XMRig miner into memory using memfd Linux utility
Payload execution straight from memory evading traditional security solutions
Impacted Systems: Cloud instances with publicly accessible Jupyter Notebook services
Attack Vector: Initial access via publicly accessible Jupyter Notebook services with unrestricted system commands
Fetching fileless payload via HTTPS GET request from paste.c-net.org
Loading and executing payload directly in Python runtime memory
